का.आ. 2600(अ).--केन्द्रीय सरकार ने, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम, 1956 (1956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा (1) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 3572(E) तारीख 22/08/2024, जो भारत के राजपत्र, 
असाधारण, भाग ॥, खण्ड 3, उपखंड () में प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा झारखंड राज्य के खूंटी जिले में NH-75E (New 
NH-20) के कि.मी. 21.340 से कि .मी. 47.700 तक के भू-खण्ड के निर्माण (चौड़ीकरण/पेग्ड शोल्डर सहित 2-लेन/4-लेन 
का बनाना आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबन्धन और प्रचालन के लोक पर्योजन के लिए वह भूमि अपेक्षित है जिसका संक्षिप्त वर्णन 
नीचे अनुसूची में दिया गया है, ऐसी भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा करती है । 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "26.09.2024" 
को "हिन्दुस्तान, दैनिक जागरण, प्रभात खबर, दैनिक भास्कर, रांची एक्सप्रेस, आजाद सिपाही, तानीम न्यूज" और 
"झारखंड जागरण" आदि में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और 
उसका उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया;

और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है; 


अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपार्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ 
की उपधारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 


और अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि 
इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप 
से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी ।

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 13th June, 2025 


S.O. 2600(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 3572(E) Dated:22/08/2024 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for construction is required for building (widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four 
laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of NH-75E (New NH-20) in the stretch of land from Km. 
21.340 to Km. 47.700 in the district of KHUNTI in the state of JHARKHAND, hereby declares its intention to acquire 
such land. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Hindustan, Dainik Jagran, Prabhat 
Khabar, Dainik Bhaskar, Ranchi Express, Aajad Sipahi, Taneem News” and “Jharkhand Jagran” etc. both dated 
26.09.2024 under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


126 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY [PART II—SEC. 3(11)] 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the |3th June, 2025 


S.O. 2599(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, S.0.l22(E) Dated:07/0/2025 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, 
Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/ 2/4-laning with paved shoulder etc.), 
Maintenance, management and operation of NH-752G in the stretch of land from (Km.0+000 to Km. 55+55) 
(Sendhwa-Khetiya MP/MH Border Road) Tehsil-Pansemal in the district of BARWANI in the state of MADHYA 
PRADESH. Hereby decleares its intention to acquire such land. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Dainik Bhaskar” and “Patrika” 
both dated 08 February 2025; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

allow or disallow the objections

और, हत्यादेली गाँव में आक्षेप प्राप्त हुए और उन पर विचार किया गया और आक्षेप का निदान किया गया है तथा 
सक्षम अधिकारी द्वारा तदनुसार आदेश पारित कर दीये गये हैं।

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 13th June, 2025 


S.O. 2606(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways number S.O. 3269 (E ), dated 12th August 2024 published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, 
section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3 (A) of the National Highways Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act ), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for Land Acquisition for improvement of curves and toll plaza for 4- 
lanning of Canacona bypass end (Km.602.900) to Polem/Karnataka border (Km.610.900) section of NH-66 in the state 
of Goa. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “The Navhind Times and Bhanagar Bhuin” 
dated 23/08/2024 under sub-section (3) of section 3 (A) of the said Act: 


And whereas, objections were not received and same have been considered by the competent authority: 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3 (D) of the said Act, the competent authority has submitted 
its report to the Central Government; 


Now therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers conferred by 
the sub-section (1) of section 3 (D) of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land specified in 
the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3 (D) of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares 
that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall vest absolutely 
in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 13th June, 2025 

59.0. 2617(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 
(widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four/six lane laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of Inner 
Ring Road in the stretch of land from Km. 34.400 to Km. 43.200 in the district of Prayagraj (Allahabad) in the state of 
UTTAR PRADESH, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 
Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this notification in 
the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of section 3C of the 
said Act. 
Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Special Land Acquisition Officer (JO) 
Prayagraj (Allahabad) in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the 
objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such 
objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either 
allow or disallow the objections. 
Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3(C) of the said Act shall be final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be inspected by 
the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

S.O. 2603(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways, 3675(E) Dated:29/08/2024 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section 
(॥) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to 
as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to 
the said notification for (Widening/Two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.), Maintenance, management and 
operation of NH333A in the stretch of land from Km. 42.2 to Km. 94.9 (Ist floor new samaharnalaya,pakur) in the 
district of PAKUR in the state of JHARKHAND, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Hindustan”, ““Dainik Jagaran” and “Dainik 
Bhaskar” on dated 05.0.2025; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and settled the 
same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has submitted 
its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares 
that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall vest absolutely 
in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 13th June, 2025 


S.O. 2609(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways, 1268(E) Dated : 19/03/2025, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section 
(1) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to 
as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to 
the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation of National 
Highway No. 146 [Bhopal (Ratnagiri Tiraha) - Vidisha (Morikodi) section] in the stretch of land from Km. 3.900 to 
Km. 11.850 in the district of BHOPAL in the state ofp MADHYA PRADESH 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in News paper “Navdunia” and “Free Press” both 
dated 26/03/2025; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has not received any objections under Section 3-C of the said ACt; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has submitted its 
report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers conferred by 
the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land specified in the 
said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that 
on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall vest absolutely in 
the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 13th June, 2025 


S.O. 2621(E).— In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 
(widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of NH744 in the 
stretch of land from Km. 31.8 to Km. 70.981 (Collectorate office, Virudhunagar) in the district of VIRUDHUNAGAR 
in the state of TAMIL NADU, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, SDRO, Virudhunagar in writing and 
shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, 
either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and after making such further 
enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be inspected 
by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 13th June, 2025 


S.O. 2675(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 4598 Dated:22/10/2024 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation of 
Ring Road in the stretch of land from Km. 0 to Km. 26 (Gorakhpur) in the district of GORAKHPUR in the state of 
UTTAR PRADESH 

And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Aaj” and “The Times of India” 


both dated 27/10/2024; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 


settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 


submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 


specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 


vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

DRAFT NOTIFICATION 


WHEREAS the Lippa-Asrang Wildlife Sanctuary falls within the Moorang Tehsil of Pooh sub- 
division of Kinnaur district, Himachal Pradesh state. It is situated between geo-coordinates North (3° 44' 
2" N and 77° I5' 00" E), East (3° 40' 32" N and 78° 8' 07" E), South (3I° 39' 29" N and 78° 7' 24" E) 
and West (3° 4]' 27" N and 78° ]3' 09" E). It is a high-altitude area situated in the upper catchment of Taiti 
stream, which is an important tributary of the Sutlej River. The altitude ranges from 3000 m to 522 m. The 
sanctuary beholds a unique landscape of dry Trans-Himalayan region with most of the sanctuary area being 
largely flat and in part barren cold desert; 


AND WHEREAS the Lippa-Asrang was first notified as a sanctuary in 974 vide Himachal 
Pradesh State Government notification number 5-/70-SP, dated 27-04-974. Thereafter, the sanctuary was 
finally notified after its rationalization under section 26A of the Wildlife Protection Act (972) on 7" June, 
203, vide notification number FEE-B-F(6)-!/2005-II/Lippa Asrang. The area of the Wildlife Sanctuary is 
3] square kilometers; 


AND WHEREAS the sanctuary and most of the areas are isolated both physio-graphically and 
climatically consisting of forest type like Alpine Scrubs and Alpine pastures. The Sanctuary harbour many 
threatened species of flora and fauna. The prominent species including RET species found in the sanctuary 
includes, Himalayan Tahr (Hemitragus jemlahicus), Himalayan Brown Bear (Ursus arctos isabellinus), 
Himalayan Black Bear (Ursus thibetanus laniger), Musk Deer (Moschus leucogaster), Ibex (Capra ibex), 
Blue Sheep (Pseudois nayaur), Goral (Naemorhedus goral), etc. The Sanctuary is home to the magnificent 
Snow Leopard (Panthera uncia) which is the State Animal of Himachal Pradesh and a flagship species for 
conservation of Trans-Himalayan region; 


AND WHEREAS the sanctuary is an important bird area renowned for its diverse birdlife, 
attracting birdwatchers and ornithologists. The sanctuary serves as a wintering ground for several migratory 
birds. The avifauna and other insects species found in the sanctuary includes Golden Eagle (Aquila 
chrysaetos), Himalayan Griffon Vulture (Gyps himalayensis), Snow Partridge (Lerwa lerwa), Himalayan 
Monal (Lophophorus impejanus), Alpine Accentor (Prunella collaris), Lammergeier (Gypaetus barbatus), 
Himalayan Snowcock (Tetraogallus himalayensis), Egyptian vulture (Neophron percnopterus), Ram chakor 
(Alectoris chukar), White capped redstart (Phoenicurus leucocephalus), Himalayan Buzzard (Buteo 
refectus), Common Banded Awl (Hasora chromus), Indian Fritillary (Argynnis hyperbius), Painted Lady 
(Vanessa cardui), Indian Skipper (Hesperia comma) etc.; 


AND WHEREAS the sanctuary supports a wide variety of plant species, including many rare and 
endemic ones. The varied habitats, from alpine meadows to dense forests, harbor a rich assortment of 
vegetation which includes Betula utilis, Pinus wallichiana, Artemisia brevifolia, Heracleum candicans, 
Thymus linearis, Bergenia stracheyi, Bistorta affinis, Rhododendron anthopogon, Cedrus deodara, 
Juniperus communis, Skimmia laureola, Aconitum heterophyllum, Gentiana kurroo, Jurinea macrocephalla, 
Ephedra gerardiana, etc.; 


AND WHEREAS it is necessary to conserve and protect the area, extent and boundary of Lippa- 
Asrang Wildlife Sanctuary which is specified in paragraph | given below in this notification as Eco-sensitive

NOW THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (l) and clauses (५) and 
(xiv) of sub-section (2) and sub-section (3) of section 3 of the Environment (Protection) Act 986 (29 of 
986) read with sub-rule (3) of rule 5 of the Environment (Protection) Rules, 986, the Central Government 
hereby notifies an Eco-Sensitive Zone around the boundary of Lippa-Asrang Wildlife Sanctuary (herein 
after referred to as the Eco-sensitive Zone) details of which are as under, namely: - 


l. Extent and boundaries of Eco-Sensitive Zone.- 


(.) The Eco-sensitive Zone is extends from | kilometer to 20.527 kilometer around the boundary of 
Lippa-Asrang Wildlife Sanctuary encompassing Eco-sensitive Zone area of 298.469 square kilometer. 
Out of this 25.68 square kilometer land is waste land, 56.08 square kilometer is snow covered, 4.74 
square kilometer is grassland and streams accounts for |.969 square kilometer. 


(2) The boundary description of the Eco Sensitive Zone is appended as Annexure I. 


(3) The various maps of the Eco-sensitive Zone is appended as Annexure II A, Annexure II B and 
Annexure वा C and Annexure II 0 


(4) Geo Coordinates on the boundary of Lippa Asrang Wildlife Sanctuary and its Eco-sensitive zone 
are appended as Annexure —III. 


(5) There are no village within the Eco-sensitive Zone. 
2. Zonal Master Plan for Eco-Sensitive Zone- 


() The State Government shall, for the purposes of the Eco-sensitive Zone prepare a Zonal Master 
Plan within a period of two years from the date of publication of this notification in the Official 
Gazette, in consultation with local people and adhering to the stipulations given in this notification 
for approval of the competent authority in the State Government. 


(2) The Zonal Master Plan for the Eco-sensitive Zone shall be prepared by the State Government in 
such manner as is specified in this notification and also in consonance with the relevant Central and 
State laws and the guidelines issued by the Central Government, if any. 


(3) The Zonal Master Plan shall be prepared in consultation with the following Departments of the 
State Government, for integrating the ecological and environmental considerations into the said 
plan:- 


i. Forest; 
ii. Revenue; 
iii. Agriculture and Horticulture; 
iv. Panchayati Raj and Rural Development; 
v. Irrigation and Flood Control; 
vi. Tourism; 
vii. Municipality and Urban Development; 
viii. Public Works Department and Highways; 
छह. Himachal Pradesh State Pollution Control Board; 
Xx. Environment; 


(4) The Zonal Master Plan shall not impose any restriction on the approved existing land use, 
infrastructure and activities, unless so specified in this notification and the Zonal Master Plan shall 
factor in improvement of all infrastructure and activities to be more efficient and eco-friendly. 


(5) The Zonal Master Plan shall provide for restoration of denuded areas, conservation of existing 
water bodies, management of catchment areas, watershed management, groundwater management,

environment that need attention. 


(6) The Zonal Master Plan shall demarcate all the existing worshipping places, villages and urban 
settlements, types and kinds of forests, agricultural areas, green area, such as, parks, horticultural 
areas, orchards, lakes and other water bodies with supporting maps giving details of existing and 
proposed land use features. 


(7) The Zonal Master Plan shall regulate development in Eco-sensitive Zone and adhere to 
prohibited and regulated activities listed in the Table in paragraph 4 and also ensure and promote 
eco-friendly development for security of local communities’ livelihood. 


(8) The Zonal Master Plan shall be co-terminus with the Regional Development Plan. 


(9) The Zonal Master Plan so approved shall be the reference document for the Monitoring 
Committee for carrying out its functions of monitoring in accordance with the provisions of this 
notification. 


(0) Pending preparation and approval of the Zonal Master Plan, any new developmental activities 
shall be governed by provisions specified at sub-para (l) and (2) of paragraph 6. 


3. Measures to be taken by the State Government. - The State Government shall take the following 
measures for giving effect to the provisions of this notification, namely:- 


Land use.— (a) Forests, horticulture areas, agricultural areas, orchards, parks, lakes and open 
spaces earmarked for recreational purposes in the Eco-sensitive Zone shall not be used or converted 
into areas for commercial or residential or industrial activities; 


Provided that the conversion of agricultural and other lands, for the purposes other 
than that specified at part (a) above, within the Eco-sensitive Zone may be permitted on the 
recommendation of the Monitoring Committee, and with the prior approval of the competent 
authority under Regional Town Planning Act and other rules and regulations of the Central 
Government or the State Government as applicable and vide provisions of this notification, to meet 
the residential needs of the local residents and for activities such as- 


widening and strengthening of existing roads and construction of new roads; 
construction and renovation of infrastructure and civic amenities; 
small scale industries not causing pollution; 


cottage industries including village industries; convenience stores and local amenities supporting 
eco-tourism including home stay; and 


promoted activities given in paragraph 4: 


Provided further that no use of tribal land shall be permitted for commercial and industrial 
development activities without the prior approval of the competent authority under Regional Town 
Planning Act and other rules and regulations of the State Government and without compliance of the 
provisions of article 244 of the Constitution or the law for the time being in force, including the 
Scheduled Tribes and Other Traditional Forest Dwellers (Recognition of Forest Rights) Act, 2006 (2 
of 2007): 


Provided also that any error appearing in the land records within the Eco-sensitive Zone shall 
be corrected by the State Government, after obtaining the views of Monitoring Committee, once in 
each case and the correction of said error shall be intimated to the Central Government in the Ministry 
of Environment, Forest and Climate Change: 


Provided also that the above correction of error shall not include change of land use 
in any case except as provided under this sub-paragraph:

Provided also that there shall be no consequential reduction in green area, such as 
forest area and agricultural area and efforts shall be made to reforest the unused or unproductive 
agricultural areas with afforestation and habitat restoration activities. 


Natural water bodies.-The catchment areas of all natural springs shall be identified and plans for 
their conservation and rejuvenation shall be incorporated in the Zonal Master Plan and the 
guidelines shall be drawn up by the State Government in such a manner as to prohibit development 
activities at or near these areas which are detrimental to such areas. 


Tourism or eco-tourism.- (a) All new eco-tourism activities or expansion of existing tourism 
activities within the Eco-sensitive Zone shall be as per the Tourism Master Plan for the Eco- 
sensitive Zone; 


the Tourism Master Plan shall be prepared by the State Department of Tourism in consultation with 
the State Departments of Environment and Forests; 


the Tourism Master Plan shall form a component of the Zonal Master Plan; 


the Tourism Master Plan shall be drawn based on the study of carrying capacity of the Eco- 
sensitive Zone; 


the activities of eco-tourism shall be regulated as under, namely:- 


new construction of hotels and resorts shall not be allowed within one kilometre from the boundary 
of the protected area or upto the extent of the Eco-sensitive Zone, whichever is nearer; 


Provided that beyond the distance of one kilometer from the boundary of the protected 
area till the extent of the Eco-sensitive Zone, the establishment of new hotels and resorts 
shall be allowed only in pre-defined and designated areas for eco-tourism facilities as per 
Tourism Master Plan; 


all new tourism activities or expansion of existing tourism activities within the Eco-sensitive Zone 
shall be in accordance with the guidelines issued by the Central Government and the eco-tourism 
guidelines issued by the National Tiger Conservation Authority (as amended from time to time) 
with emphasis on eco-tourism, eco-education and eco-development; 


until the Zonal Master Plan is approved, development for tourism and expansion of existing 
tourism activities shall be permitted by the concerned regulatory authorities based on the actual site 
specific scrutiny and recommendation of the Monitoring Committee and no new hotel, resort or 
commercial establishment construction shall be permitted within Eco-sensitive Zone area. 


Natural heritage.- All sites of valuable natural heritage in the Eco-sensitive Zone, such as the gene 
pool reserve areas, rock formations, waterfalls, springs, gorges, groves, caves, points, walks, rides, 
cliffs, etc. shall be identified and a heritage conservation plan shall be drawn up for their 
preservation and conservation as a part of the Zonal Master Plan. 


Man-made heritage sites.- Buildings, structures, artefacts, areas and precincts of historical, 
architectural, aesthetic, and cultural significance shall be identified in the Eco-sensitive Zone and 
heritage conservation plan for their conservation shall be prepared as part of the Zonal Master Plan. 


Noise pollution. - Prevention and control of noise pollution in the Eco-sensitive Zone shall be 
carried out in accordance with the provisions of the Noise Pollution (Regulation and Control) 
Rules, 2000 and its amendments. 


Air pollution.- Prevention and control of air pollution in the Eco-sensitive Zone shall be carried 
out in accordance with the provisions of the Air (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 98] 
(4 of 98) and Environment (Protection) Act, 986 and the rules made there under these Acts. 


Discharge of effluents.- The discharge of treated effluent in Eco-sensitive Zone shall be in 
accordance with the provisions of the Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 974 (6 of 
974) and Environment (Protection) Act, 986 and the rules made there under these Acts. 


Solid wastes.- Disposal and Management of solid wastes shall be as under:- 


the solid waste disposal and management in the Eco-sensitive Zone shall be carried out in 
accordance with the Solid Waste Management Rules, 206, published by the Government of India

Construction and demolition waste management.- The construction and demolition waste 
management in the Eco-sensitive Zone shall be carried out as per the provisions of the Construction 
and Demolition Waste Management Rules, 206 published by the Government of India in the 
Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change vide notification number G.S.R. 37(E), 
dated the 29" March, 206, as amended from time to time. 


E-waste.- The e - waste management in the Eco-sensitive Zone shall be carried out as per the 
provisions of the E-Waste Management Rules, 206, published by the Government of India in the 
Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, as amended from time to time. 


Vehicular traffic. The vehicular movement of traffic shall be regulated in a habitat friendly 
manner and specific provisions in this regard shall be incorporated in the Zonal Master Plan and till 
such time as the Zonal Master plan is prepared and approved by the competent authority in the 
State Government, the Monitoring Committee shall monitor compliance of vehicular movement 
under the relevant Acts and the rules and regulations made thereunder. 


Vehicular pollution.- Prevention and control of vehicular pollution shall be in compliance with 
applicable laws and efforts shall be made for use of cleaner fuels. 


Industrial units.— (a) On or after the publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, no new 
polluting industries shall be permitted to be set up within the Eco-sensitive Zone; 


(b) only non-polluting industries shall be allowed within Eco-sensitive Zone as per the 
classification of Industries in the guidelines issued by the Central Pollution Control Board in 
February, 206, as amended from time to time, unless so specified in this notification, and 
in addition, the non-polluting cottage industries shall be promoted. 


Protection of hill slopes.- The protection of hill slopes shall be as under:- 
the Zonal Master Plan shall indicate areas on hill slopes where no construction shall be permitted; 


construction on existing steep hill slopes or slopes with a high degree of erosion shall not be 
permitted. 


List of activities prohibited or to be regulated within Eco-sensitive Zone- 


All activities in the Eco-Sensitive Zone shall be governed by the provisions of the Environment Act and 
the rules made there under including the Environmental Impact Assessment Notification, 2006 (or the 
latest notification) and other applicable laws including the Forest (Conservation) Act, l980 (69 of 980),

The Eco sensitive Zone boundary in terms of landscape features includes ridges like Thothi Dhar, Gmjhang

Kinnaur Territorial Forest Division. Rivers- Gumjhang Nalla, Tepong Nalla, Ladsa Nalla, Wari Nalla and 
Taiti Khad. Glaciers- Metanglongpa Glacier, Gumjhang Glacier and Ladsa Glacier. Temporary Gaddi Deras- 
Dharwali, Dhar Ladsa, Dhar Tepong, Dhar Gumjhang, Dhar Metang and Dhar Kiyari. The boundary 
descitpion in different directions is as under: 


North: North East boundary of the Eco sensitive Zone is shared with Pin Valley National Park and North 
West is shared with Rupi Bhaba Wildlife Sanctuary. 

South: Tokto and Asarang are two villages located south of the Eco sensitive Zone falling in Moorang 
Range. 


East: East Boundaries of the Eco sensitive Zone is aligned with Moorang Range of Kinnaur Territorial Forest 
Division and Rupi Bhaba Wildlife Sanctuary; some part of boundary with Proposed Eco sensitive Zone of 
Rupi Bhaba Wildlife Sanctuary. 


West: Western side of the Eco sensitive Zone is aligned with the Eco sensitive Zone of Great Himalayan 
National Park and Sarahan Range of Rampur Territorial Forest Division.

का.आ. 2596(अ).-- केन्द्रीय सरकार ने, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम, 1956 (1956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा (1) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 3571(अ) तारीख 22/08/2024, जो भारत के राजपत्र, 
असाधारण, भाग Il, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (ii) A प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा राजस्थान राज्य के धौलपुर जिले में राष्ट्रीय 
राजमार्ग संख्या 719डी (6 लेन आगरा - ग्वालियर ग्रीन फील्ड हाइवे) के कि.मी. 20.140 से कि.मी.46.885 (राजाखेड़ा 
तहसील,धोलपुर) तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण (चौड़ीकरण/पेग्ड शोल्डर सहित 2-लेन/4-लेन / 6-लेन का बनाना 
आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के 
अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "06.09.2024 " को 
"राजस्थान पत्रिका" और "टाइम्स ऑफ इंडिया" दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा BAT के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और उसका उचित 
रूप से निपटान किया गया; 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी रिपोर्ट दे 
दी है;

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 13th June, 2025 

S.O. 2596(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 9.00. 3571(E) Dated:22/08/2024 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, 
Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning/6 laning etc.), maintenance, 
management and operation of National Highway No. 719D (6 lane Agra-Gwalior Greenfield Highway) in the stretch 
of land from Km. 20.140 to Km. 46.885 (Rajakhera Tehsil, Dholpur) in the district of DHOLPUR in the state of 
RAJASTHAN; 
And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Rajasthan Patrika” and “Times of India” 
both dated 06.09.2024; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 
And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and settled the 
same appropriately; 
And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has submitted its 
report to the Central Government; 
Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers conferred by 
the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land specified in the 
said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 
And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares 
that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall vest 
absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 13th June, 2025 

S.O. 2674(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways, S.O. 1286 Dated:19/03/2025, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part I, Section 3, Sub-section 
(1) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to 
as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to 
the said notification for building (widening Two/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation of NH- 
319D from Phoolpur to Mugrabadshahpur from Km. from near Kodahu Km. 47/225 of NH-319D and ending near 
Nauwadandi Km. 218/880 of NH-31) (Design Ch. Km. 0+000 to Km 44355 : total length 4.335 Km.) under NH(o) EPC 
Mode, District Jaunpur in the state of of UTTAR PRADESH, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land; 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Nav Bharat Times, dated 29 March 
2025 & The times of India dated 29 March 2025 under sub section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and settled 


the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 


submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 


specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall vest 


absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

5.0. 2649(E).—Whereas, by the notification of the Government of India, in the Ministry of Railways

issued under sub-section () of section 20A of the Railway (Amendment) Act, 2008 ( of 2008) (hereinafter referred 
to as the said Act), the Central Government declares its intention to acquire the land specified in the schedule annexed 
to the said notification for the purpose of execution, maintenance, management and operation of Special Railway 
Project, namely new BG line project from Dahod to Indore (through Jhabua, Sardarpur, Dhar and Pithampur) 204.76 
km in Jhabua district in the State of Madhya Pradesh. 


And whereas, the substance of the said notification was published in daily News Papers — “Free Press” & “Raj 
Express” dated 07 December, 2024 under sub section (4) of section 20A of the said Act. 


And whereas, in Surinala village no objections were received and competent Authority have passed the orders 
accordingly; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section 20E of the said Act, the competent authority has submitted its report to the 
Central Government; 


Now therefore, upon receipt of the report of the Competent Authority and in exercise of the powers conferred by sub- 
section (l) of section 20 E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the lands specified in the 
schedule annexed hereto shall be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 20 E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares 
that on publication of this notification in the official Gazette, the land specified in the schedule annexed hereto shall 
vest absolutely in the Central government free from all encumbrances.

MINISTRY OF RAILWAYS 
[Western Railway (Construction Organization)] 
NOTIFICATION 
Mumbai, the | lth June, 2025 


5.0. 2648(E).—Whereas, by the notification of the Government of India, in the Ministry of Railways 
(Railway Board), number, 8.0. 524(E) dated the 28 November, 2024 published in Gazette of India, Extraordinary, 
Part II, section 3 Sub-section (ii), dated the 28 November, 2024 (hereinafter referred to as the said notification ) and 
issued under sub-section (l) of section 20A of the Railway (Amendment) Act, 2008 ( of 2008) (hereinafter referred 
to as the said Act), the Central Government declares its intention to acquire the land specified in the schedule annexed 
to the said notification for the purpose of execution, maintenance, management and operation of Special Railway 
Project, namely new BG line project from Dahod to Indore (through Jhabua, Sardarpur, Dhar and Pithampur) 204.76 
km in Jhabua district in the State of Madhya Pradesh. 


And whereas, the substance of the said notification was published in daily News Papers — “Free Press” & “Raj 
Express” dated 07 December, 2024 under sub section (4) of section 20A of the said Act. 


And whereas, in Saad village no objections were received and competent Authority have passed the orders 
accordingly; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section 20E of the said Act, the competent authority has submitted its report to the 
Central Government; 


Now therefore, upon receipt of the report of the Competent Authority and in exercise of the powers conferred by sub- 
section (l) of section 20 E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the lands specified in the 
schedule annexed hereto shall be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 20 E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares 
that on publication of this notification in the official Gazette, the land specified in the schedule annexed hereto shall 
vest absolutely in the Central government free from all encumbrances.

का.आ. 2616(अ).--- केन्द्रीय सरकार, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम 1956 (1956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके पश्चात्‌ उक्त 
अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उप-धारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह समाधान हो जाने के पश्चात्‌ कि 
उड़ीसा राज्य के कटक जिले में Greenfield Highway के कि.मी. 53.4 से कि.मी.61.1 (एट्-अथागढ़,पो-अथागढ़,डिस्ट-कटक) तक के 
भू-खण्ड के निर्माण (चौड़ीकरण/पेव्ड शोल्डर सहित 2-लेन/4-लेन का बनाना आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबन्धन और प्रचालन के लोक प्रयोजन के 
लिए वह भूमि अपेक्षित है जिसका संक्षिप्त वर्णन नीचे अनुसूची में दिया गया है, ऐसी भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा 
करती है। 

कोई भी व्यक्ति, जो उक्त भूमि में हितबद्ध है, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3ग की उप-धारा (1) के अधीन पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए 
ऐसी भूमि के उपयोग पर राजपत्र में इस अधिसूचना के प्रकाशन की तारीख से इक्कीस दिन के भीतर अपनी आपत्ति प्रकट कर सकेगा | 

ऐसी प्रत्येक आपत्ति सक्षम प्राधिकारी, अर्थात्‌ तहसीलदार,अथागढ़ को लिखित रूप मे प्रस्तुत की जाएगी और उसमें उसके 
आधार अधिकथित किए जाएंगे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी, आपत्तिकर्ता को व्यक्तिगत रूप मे या किसी विधिक पेशेवर द्वारा सुने जाने का 
अवसर देगा और ऐसी आपत्तियों की सुनवाई के पश्चात्‌ तथा ऐसी और जाँच करने के पश्चात्‌, यदि कोई हो, जिसे सक्षम प्राधिकारी आवश्यक 
समझे, आदेश द्वारा या तो आपत्तियों को अनुज्ञात कर सकेगा या अननुज्ञात कर सकेगा | 


उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3ग की उप-धारा (2) के अधीन सक्षम प्राधिकारी द्वारा किया गया कोई भी आदेश अंतिम होगा । 
इस अधिसूचना के अंतर्गत आने वाली भूमि के रेखांक और अन्य ब्यौरे सक्षम प्राधिकारी के उक्त कार्यालय में उपलब्ध हैं और

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 13th June, 2025 


S.O. 2616(E).— In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National HighwaysAct, 
1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for the 
public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 
(widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of Greenfield 
Highway in the stretch of land from Km. 53.4 to Km. 61.1 (At-Athagarh,Po-Athagarh,Dist-Cuttack) in the district of 
Cuttack in the state of ODISHA, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Tahasildar, Athagarh in writing and 
shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, 
either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and after making such further 
enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

annexed to the said notification for construction of Road Maintenance, management and operation of NH-l2l(New

conferred by the sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land

declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall

का.आ. 2639(अ).--भारत सरकार, रेल मंत्रालय, उत्तर रेलवे (निर्माण संगठन) की अधिसूचना संख्या 
का.आ. 683(ई) दिनांक 7 फरवरी, 2025 जो कि भारत के राजपत्र, असाधारण, भाग (11) खंड 3, उप-खंड 
(11) में प्रकाशित की गई थी, के तहत रेलवे अधिनियम, 1989 (1989 का 24) की धारा 20ए की उप-धारा 
(४) के अंतर्गत “मुफ्तीगंज (एन-ई-आर-) जौनपुर-महगावाँ बाईपास (जौनपुर जंक्शन) 15 कि-मी- को 
जोड़ने वाली कार्ड-लाइन” निर्माण, रखरखाव, प्रबंधन एवं संचालन हेतु उत्तर प्रदेश राज्य के जौनपुर जिले में 
विशेष रेलवे परियोजना के लिए भूमि अधिग्रहण की मंशा घोषित की गई थी। 

और उक्त, अधिसूचना के सारांश की सूचना दैनिक जागरण, और टाइम्स ऑफ इंडिया में 15 फरवरी 
2025 को रेलवे अधिनियम की धारा 20ए की उप-धारा (4) के तहत प्रकाशित की गई थी ; 


और जहां, इस संबंध में कोई आपत्ति प्राप्त नहीं हुई और सक्षम प्राधिकारी द्वारा उसके अनुरूप आदेश 
पारित किए गए हैं; 

और जहां, रेलवे अधिनियम की धारा 20 ई की उप-धारा (3) के तहत सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने अपनी 
रिपोर्ट केंद्र सरकार को प्रस्तुत कर दी है; 


अत:, केंद्र सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की रिपोर्ट प्राप्त होने के पश्चात और रेलवे अधिनियम, 1989 की 
धारा 20 इ की उप-धारा (1) SRI प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए,

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 11th June, 2025 


9.0. 2639(E).—Whereas, by the notification of the Government of India, in the Ministry of Railways, 
Northern Railway (Construction Organization), number, 8.0. 683(E), dated the 7th February, 2025, published in 
Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section (ii) (hereafter referred to as the said notification) under 
sub-section (1) of section 20A of the Railway Act, 1989 (24 of 1989) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the 
Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the schedule annexed to the said 
notification for execution, maintenance, management and operation of Special Railway Project, namely, “Chord Line 
Connecting MFJ (NER)-JNU-MGWN Bypassing JNU (Jaunpur Jn.) 1.5 Km” in the village Purshottampur & 
shdaudpur of district Jaunpur in the state of UP.) 


And whereas, the substance of the said notification was published in daily newspapers Dainik Jagran, dated 
the 15th February 2025, Times of India dated 15th February 2025 under sub-section (4) of section 20A of the said 
Act; 


And whereas, no objections were received and the same have been considered, and accordingly orders have 
been passed; And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 20E of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority, and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by sub-section (1) of section 20E of the Railways Act, 1989, the Central Government hereby declares that 
the lands specified in the Schedule annexed hereto shall be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the Schedule annexed 
hereto shall vest absolutely in the Central Government free from all encumbrances.

और उक्त अधिसूचना की सारांश सूचना दैनिक जागरण, और हिंदुस्तान टाइम्स, में 15 फरवरी 2025 को

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 11th June, 2025 


S.O. 2638(E).—Whereas, by the notification of the Government of India, in the Ministry of 
Railways, Northern Railway (Construction Organization), number, 8.0. 684(E), dated the 7 th February , 2025, 
published in Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part I, Section 3, Sub-section (1) (hereafter referred to as the said 
notification) under sub-section (1) of section 20A of the Railway Act, 1989 (24 of 1989) (hereinafter referred to as the 
said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the schedule annexed to the 
said notification for execution, maintenance, management and operation of Special Railway Project, namely, “Chord 
Line Connecting DJD (NER)-SHG-BWI Bypassing SHG (Shahganj Jn.) 5.7 Km” Reg- villages Godila. Takha (West) 
& Takha (East) Of Tehsil: Shahganj, District: Jaunpur in the state of Uttar Pradesh ; 


And whereas, the substance of the said notification was published in daily newspapers Dainik Jagran, dated 
the 15th February 2025 , Hindustan Times dated 15th February 2025 under sub-section (4) of section 20A of the said 
Act; 


8 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY [PART II—SECc. 3(1) | 


And whereas, no objections were received and the same have been considered, and accordingly orders have 
been passed; And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 20E of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority, and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by sub-section (1) of section 20E of the Railways Act, 1989, the Central Government hereby declares that 
the lands specified in the Schedule annexed hereto shall be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the Schedule annexed 
hereto shall vest absolutely in the Central Government free from all encumbrances.

जबकी सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा ३-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ती प्राप्त हुई है,जिस पर विचार किया गया है और उसका 
उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया; 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा ३ घ की उपधारा (१) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है; 


अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा ३ घ 
की उपधारा (१) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए यह धोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का पूर्वोक्त 
प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 


और अब केन्द्रीय सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा ३ घ की उपधारा (२) के अनुसरण में, यह घोषणा करता हू. कि 
इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि, सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त हो कर आत्यन्तिक रूप 
से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी ।

और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख

New Delhi, the 13th June, 2025 


S.O. 2673(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 469-E Dated:27/01/2025 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-

referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for construction and Maintenance, management and operation of NH-248A in the 
stretch of land from Km. 36.00 to Km. 47.920 in the district of Kotputli-Behror in the state of RAJASTHAN 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “13.02.2025” in “Times of India” 
and dated "12.02.2025" in" Vande Jaipur";under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act;

And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section ३-९, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

Central Government declared its intention to be acquired the land specified in the Schedule annexed to the said 
notification for execution, maintenance, management and operation of the Special Railway Project namely, Dabhoi — 
Samalaya Gauge Conversion Project in District Vadodara in the State of Gujarat. 


And, whereas, the substance of the said notification was published in daily local newspaper “the indian 
express” dated 11.07. 2024 & 24.02. 2025 and “ divya bhaskar ” dated 11.07. 202424 & .02. 2025 under

And, whereas, objection has been received & resolved by the competent authority. 


And, whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (I) of section 20E of the said Act, the competent authority Dabhoi & 
Savali has submitted its report of the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority, and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by sub-section (1) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the schedule annexed hereto shall be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And, further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central government here by 
declares that on publication of this notification in the official Gazette the land specified in the schedule annexed hereto 
shall vest absolutely in the Central Government free from all encumbrances.

आपत्ति प्रकट कर सकेगा | 
ऐसी प्रत्येक आपत्ति सक्षम प्राधिकारी, अर्थात्‌ संयुक्त कलेक्टर, बापटला को लिखित रूप मे प्रस्तुत की जाएगी और 
उसमें उसके आधार अधिकथित किए जाएंगे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी, आपत्तिकर्ता को व्यक्तिगत रूप मे या किसी विधिक 
पेशेवर द्वारा सुने जाने का अवसर देगा और ऐसी आपत्तियों की सुनवाई के पश्चात्‌ तथा ऐसी और जाँच करने के पश्चात्‌, यदि

New Delhi, the ]3th June, 2025 


5.0. 2623(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section () of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 
(widening/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of NH544D in the stretch of land from Km. 
320.300 to Km.405.600 (Vinukonda - Guntur) in the district of Bapatla in the state of Andhra Pradesh, hereby declares 
its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this notification in 
the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section() of section 3C of the 
said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Joint Collector, Bapatla in writing and shall 
set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either 
in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and after making such further enquiry, if 
any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the objections.

Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be final.

by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

report to the Central Government;

NOTIFICATION 
Jaipur, the l3th June, 2025 


S.O. 2652(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India, in the Ministry of Railways 
(Railway Board), number S.O. 3900(E) dated l2th September, 2024 published in Gazette of India, Extraordinary, 
Part वी, Section-3, Sub section (ii) (herein after referred to as the said notification) under sub-section (l) of section 
20A of the Railways (Amendment) Act, 2008 (l of 2008) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act). The Central 
Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to the said notification for the 
purpose execution, maintenance, management and operation of Special Railway Project, namely, Badi Sadr — 
Nimach New Broad gauge line project in District Pratapgarh in the State of Rajasthan. 


[भाग Il—are 3(ii)] भारत का राजपत्र : असाधारण i! 


And, whereas, the substance of the said notification was published in the daily local newspapers “Dainik 
Bhasker” dated l5th September, 2024 and “Rajasthan Patrika” dated l6th September, 2024 under sub-section (4) of 
section 20A of the said Act; 


And whereas, no objections has been received by the competent authority; 


And, whereas, in pursuance of sub section () of section 20E of the said act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority, and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by sub-section (l) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the schedule annexed hereto shall be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And, Further in pursuance of sub section (2) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the official Gazette, that land specified in the schedule annexed 
hereto shall vest absolutely in the Central Government free from all encumbrances.

Mumbai, the |3th June, 2025 
Under clause 20A of the Railway (Amendment) Act 2008 


S.O. 2626(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (l) of Section 20A of the Railways Act, 
989 (24 of 989) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for the 
public purpose, the land, the brief description of which has been given in schedule annexed here to, is required for 
purpose of execution, maintenance, management and operation of Special Railway Project, namely “Double chord 
line between Nilje & Kopar Railway project” in the district of Thane in the State of Maharashtra, hereby declares its 
intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land M/s, within a period of thirty days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, raise objection to the acquisition and use of such land for the aforesaid purpose 
under sub-section () of section 20D of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority namely, Sub-Divisional Officer Kalyan, 
District Thane, Maharashtra in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof, and the Competent Authority shall give 
the objector the opportunity of being heard, either in person or by legal practitioner and M/s, after hearing such 
objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the competent authority thinks necessary, by order, either 
allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 20D of the said Act shall be 
final. 


The land plans and other details of the land covered under this notification are available and can be inspected 
by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

अनुसूची मे विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि को, मध्यप्रदेश राज्य के धार जिले में विशेष रेल परियोजना अर्थात, दाहोद से इंदौर

के आशय की घोषणा की थी।

है तथा सक्षम अधिकारी द्वारा तदनुसार आदेश पारित कर दीये गये हैं।

MINISTRY OF RAILWAYS 
[Western Railway (Construction Organization)] 
NOTIFICATION 
Mumbai, the | lth June, 2025 


5.0. 264(E).—Whereas, by the notification of the Government of India, in the Ministry of Railways 
(Railway Board), number, S.O. 568(E) dated the 30 November, 2024 published in Gazette of India, Extraordinary, 
Part II, section 3 Sub-section (ii), dated the 30 November, 2024 (hereinafter referred to as the said notification ) and 
issued under sub-section (l) of section 20A of the Railway (Amendment) Act, 2008 (I! of 2008) (hereinafter referred 
to as the said Act), the Central Government declares its intention to acquire the land specified in the schedule annexed 
to the said notification for the purpose of execution, maintenance, management and operation of Special Railway 
Project, namely new BG line project from Dahod to Indore (through Jhabua, Sardarpur, Dhar and Pithampur) 204.76 
km in Jhabua district in the State of Madhya Pradesh. 


And whereas, the substance of the said notification was published in daily News Papers — “Free Press” & 
“Raj Express” dated 08 December, 2024 under sub section (4) of section 20A of the said Act. 


And whereas, in Paledi village no objections were received and competent Authority have passed the orders 
accordingly; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section 20E of the said Act, the competent authority has submitted its 
report to the Central Government; 


Now therefore, upon receipt of the report of the Competent Authority and in exercise of the powers conferred 
by sub-section () of section 20 E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the lands specified in 
the schedule annexed hereto shall be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 20 E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the official Gazette, the land specified in the schedule annexed 
hereto shall vest absolutely in the Central government free from all encumbrances.

पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा () के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क परिवहन 
और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 7855(E) तारीख 24/04/2025, जो भारत के राजपत्र, असाधारण, 
AMT I, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (ii) A प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा उत्तर प्रदेश राज्य के जौनपुर जिले में NH-435A के कि.मी. 34.9 
से PH.AT.73.475 (भदोही से जौनपुर) के अंतर्गत निर्माण/चौड़ीकरण (दो/चार लेन का बनाने आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और 
प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "30/04/2025" को 
"आज" और "द टाईम्स ऑफ इण्डिया" दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और उसका 
उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया;

और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (॥) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है; 


अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ 
की उपधारा (॥) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का पूर्वोक्त 
प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 


और अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि 


इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप से 
केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी ।

5.0. 2642(E).—Whereas, by the notification of the Government of India, in the Ministry of Railways 
(Railway Board), number, S.O. 562(E) dated the 29 November, 2024 published in Gazette of India, Extraordinary, 
Part II, section 3 Sub-section (ii), dated the 29 November, 2024 (hereinafter referred to as the said notification ) and 
issued under sub-section (l) of section 20A of the Railway (Amendment) Act, 2008 (I! of 2008) (hereinafter referred 
to as the said Act), the Central Government declares its intention to acquire the land specified in the schedule annexed 
to the said notification for the purpose of execution, maintenance, management and operation of Special Railway 
Project, namely new BG line project from Dahod to Indore (through Jhabua, Sardarpur, Dhar and Pithampur) 204.76 
km in Jhabua district in the State of Madhya Pradesh. 


And whereas, the substance of the said notification was published in daily News Papers — “Free Press” & 
“Raj Express” dated 07 December, 2024 under sub section (4) of section 20A of the said Act. 


And whereas, in Fatepura village no objections were received and competent Authority have passed the 
orders accordingly; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section 20E of the said Act, the competent authority has submitted its 
report to the Central Government; 


Now therefore, upon receipt of the report of the Competent Authority and in exercise of the powers conferred 
by sub-section () of section 20 E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the lands specified in 
the schedule annexed hereto shall be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 20 E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the official Gazette, the land specified in the schedule annexed 
hereto shall vest absolutely in the Central government free from all encumbrances.

Constitution and in supersession of the Ministry of Science and Technology, Department of Science and 
Technology Survey of India, Stenographer Grade II, Group 'C' Post Recruitment Rules, 208, except as 
respects things done or omitted to be done before such supersession, the President hereby makes the following 
tules regulating the method of recruitment to the post of Stenographer Grade II in the Survey of India under 
the Department of Science and Technology, Ministry of Science and Technology, namely:- 


. Short title and commencement. - (|) These rules may be called the Ministry of Science and Technology, 
Survey of India, Stenographer Grade II, (Group ‘C’ Post) Recruitment Rules, 2025. 


(2) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 

2. Number of post, classification and Level in Pay Matrix. — The number of the said post, its classification 
and Level in the Pay Matrix attached thereto shall be as specified in columns (2) to (4) of the Schedule 
annexed to these rules. 

3. Method of recruitment, age limit, qualifications, etc. — The method of recruitment, age limit, 


qualifications and other matters relating to the said post shall be as specified in columns (5) to (3) of the 
said Schedule. 


4. Disqualification. — No person, — 


(a) who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living; or 
(b) who, having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted a marriage with any person, 


shall be eligible for appointment to the said post: 


Provided that the Central Government may, if satisfied that such marriage is permissible under the 
personal law applicable to such person and the other party to the marriage and that there are other grounds 
for so doing, exempt any person from the operation of this rule.

का.आ. 2592(अ).--एस.ओ. (ई):- जबकि भारत सरकार के सड़क परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की 
अधिसूचना संख्या एस.ओ.4900 (ई) दिनांक 12 नवंबर, 2024, जो भारत के राजपत्र, असाधारण, भाग Il, खंड 3, उप- 
खंड (1) में प्रकाशित और राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम, 1956 (1956 का 48) (जिसे इसके बाद उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया 
है) की धारा 3ए की उप-धारा (1) के अंतर्गत जारी की गई थी, केंद्र सरकार ने आंध्र प्रदेश राज्य में मंडलेम (एनएच-340सी 
का मौजूदा किमी 38.000/डिजाइन किमी 30.600) से आत्मकुर (एनएच-340सी का मौजूदा किमी 73.000/डिजाइन 
किमी 66.115) (पैकेज-2) से फोर लेन तक पक्के कंधों के साथ एनएच-340सी के निर्माण (चौड़ीकरण/पक्के कंधों के साथ 
दो/चार लेन का बनाना आदि), रखरखाव, प्रबंधन और संचालन के लिए उक्त अधिसूचना से संलग्न अनुसूची में निर्दिष्ट भूमि 
का अधिग्रहण करने की अपनी मंशा की घोषणा की थी। और जबकि उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3ए 
की उपधारा (3) के अधीन दिनांक 29-11-2024 को “प्रजाशक्ति” (तेलुगु) और “द हंस इंडिया” (अंग्रेजी) दोनों में प्रकाशित 
किया गया है। 
और चूंकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने धारा 3-सी के अंतर्गत दायर आपत्तियां प्राप्त की हैं, उन पर विचार किया है तथा उनका उचित 
तरीके से निपटारा किया है। 
और जबकि, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने अपनी रिपोर्ट केन्द्रीय सरकार 
को प्रस्तुत कर दी है।

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 13th June, 2025 


S.O. 2592(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road 
Transport and Highways, number S.0.4900 (E) dated the 127 November, 2024, published in the Gazette of 
India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-Section (ii) and issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of 
the National Highways Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (herein after referred to as the said Act) the Central 
Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the schedule annexed to the said 
notification for building (widening / two / four laning with paved shoulders etc.), maintenance, management 
and operation of National Highway No.340C in the stretch of land from Mandlem (Existing Km 38.000 of 
NH-340C/ Design Km 30.600) to Atmakur (Existing Km. 73.000 of NH-340C/Design Km. 66.115) 
(Package-2) (Kurnool to Atmakur Section) in Nandyal District in the state of Andhra Pradesh. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Prajasakti” (Telugu) and 
“The Hans India” (English) both dated the 29-11-2024, under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act. 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed U/s 3-C considered and settled 
the appropriately. 

And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Competent Authority 
has submitted its report to the Central Government. 

Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the Competent Authority and in exercise of the 
powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares 
that the land specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose. 

And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government 
hereby declares that on publication of this notification in the official Gazette, the land specified in the said 
Schedule shall vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

2008 (2008 का 44) (जिसे इसमे इसके पश्चात उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 20 'क' की उपधारा (4) के अधीन 
जारी, भारत के राजपत्र, असाधारण भाग Il, खण्ड 3, उपखण्ड (ii) तारीख 30 नवम्बर, 2024 मे प्रकाशित भारत सरकार 
के रेल मंत्रालय (रेलवे बोर्ड) की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 5777 (A) तारीख 30 नवम्बर, 2024 (जिसे इसमे इसके पश्चात 
उक्त अधिसूचना कहा गया है), द्वारा उक्त अधिसूचना से उपाबध्द अनुसूची मे विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि को, मध्यप्रदेश राज्य के धार 
जिले में विशेष रेल परियोजना अर्थात, दाहोद से इंदौर जाने वाली नई बीजी लाइन परियोजना, झाबुआ, सरदारपुर, धार 
और पिथामपुर के मध्य से (204.76 किमी), स्पेशल रेलवे प्रोजेक्ट के निष्पादन, अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए 

अपेक्षित है, ऐसी भूमि का अर्जन करने के आशय की घोषणा की थी। 


और, उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 20 'क' की उपधारा (4) के अधीन दैनिक समाचार पत्रों 
अर्थात “राज एक्सप्रेस एवं फ्री प्रेस” में तारीख 07 दिसंबर, 2024 को प्रकाशित किया गया था। 


और, सेमलघाटा गाँव में आक्षेप प्राप्त हुए और उन पर विचार किया गया और आक्षेप का निदान किया गया है तथा 
सक्षम अधिकारी द्वारा तदनुसार आदेश पारित कर दीये गये हैं। 


और, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 20 'ड' की उपधारा () के अनुसरण मे सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने अपनी रिपोर्ट केन्द्रीय 
सरकार को प्रस्तुत कर दी है।

की उपधारा (॥) द्वारा प्रदत शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि इससे उपाबध्द अनुसूची मे विनिर्दिष्ट 


भूमि पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जित की जाएगी। 


और यह कि केंद्रीय सरकार उक्त अधिनियम कि धारा 20 'ड' कि उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण मे यह घोषणा करती है

होकर केन्द्रीय सरकार मे आत्यांकित रूप से निहित हो जाएगी।

के रेल मंत्रालय (रेलवे बोर्ड) की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 572 (A) तारीख 30 नवम्बर, 2024 (जिसे इसमे इसके पश्चात 
उक्त अधिसूचना कहा गया है), द्वारा उक्त अधिसूचना से उपाबध्द अनुसूची मे विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि को, मध्यप्रदेश राज्य के धार 
जिले में विशेष रेल परियोजना अर्थात, दाहोद से इंदौर जाने वाली नई बीजी लाइन परियोजना, झाबुआ, सरदारपुर, धार 
और पिथामपुर के मध्य से (204.76 किमी), स्पेशल रेलवे प्रोजेक्ट के निष्पादन, अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए 

अपेक्षित है, ऐसी भूमि का अर्जन करने के आशय की घोषणा की थी। 


और, उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 20 'क' की उपधारा (4) के अधीन दैनिक समाचार पत्रों 
अर्थात “राज एक्सप्रेस एवं फ्री प्रेस” में तारीख 07 दिसंबर, 2024 को प्रकाशित किया गया था।

अतः अब केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी से उक्त रिपोर्ट के प्राप्त होने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 20 'ड'

भूमि पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जित की जाएगी।

होकर केन्द्रीय सरकार मे आत्यांकित रूप से निहित हो जाएगी।

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 13th June, 2025 


S.O. 2670(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, S.O. 2946(E) Dated:24/07/2024 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, 
Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and 
operation of Greenfield Expressway in the stretch of land from Km. 98.3 to Km. 124.4 (Prant Office, Mehsana) in the 
district of MAHESANA in the state of GUJARAT 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Divya Bhaskar” and “The Times of 
India” both dated 01.08.2024; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Sec tion 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose;

(4) नियत तारीख पर, न्यायनिर्णयन अधिकारी उस व्यक्ति या उसके प्राधिकृत प्रतिनिधि को जिसके विरुद्ध कार्यवाही की जा

(5) न्‍्यायनिर्णयन अधिकारी, तब ऐसे व्यक्ति को प्ररूप-ा में ऐसे दस्तावेज या साक्ष्य प्रस्तुत करने का अवसर देगा, जिन्हें वह

(2) The words and expressions used in these regulations and not defined, but defined in the Act, shall have the same

3. Complaint— Any person may file a complaint in Form-I through electronic means or speed post or in person, to 
the adjudicating officer regarding any contravention of the provisions of the Act . 


4. Holding of inquiry.— () On receipt of a complaint under regulation 3, the adjudicating officer shall issue a notice in 
Form-I] to the person against whom such complaint has been filed, requiring him to show cause within such period as 
may be specified in the notice (being not less than seven days from the date of service thereof), why an inquiry should 
not be held against him. 


(2) Every notice under sub-regulation () shall indicate the nature of contravention alleged to have been committed. 


(3) After considering the cause, if any, shown by such person, the adjudicating officer is of the opinion that an inquiry 
should be held, he shall issue a notice requiring the appearance of that person personally or through a 
representative duly authorised by him on such date as may be fixed in the notice. 


(4) On the date fixed, the adjudicating officer shall explain to the person proceeded against or his authorised 
representative, of the alleged contravention and the provisions of the Act, in respect of such contravention. 


(5) The adjudicating officer shall, then, give an opportunity to such person to produce such documents or evidence in 
Form-III as he may consider relevant to the inquiry and if necessary, the hearing may be adjourned to a future
